title: 第10章 是可忍，孰不可忍
slug: 修炼狂潮全本免费-修炼狂潮最新章节列表
content_zh:
之前无论是穆振飞大战狄明，还是楚云凡一招击败穆振飞，其实都没用过武学，都只是凭借身体素质在交手。
而武技的作用就是将身体素质最大限度的发挥出来，从而击败对手。
所以所有人都很想学习，虽然教头教授的也不会是什么特别好的武技，免费的不学白不学。
所有人的目光都集中到了秦武的身上，秦武顿了顿，开口说道：“武技的重要性我也就不多做强调了，今天我要教给你们的是一套拳法，名为虎魔拳，这一套拳法乃是超古代文明之中的高手根据当时的一种魔虎而创出的一门拳法！”
“不过这一门拳法呢对于本身的修为也有一定的要求，只有到了肉身境第六重筋骨齐鸣的境界，肉身强大到一定程度，才可以自由练习，你们当中大部分人都没有达到这个境界，所以自己练习的时候要注意，一旦感觉承受不住，就别练下去了，否则要是留下了什么暗伤，就得不偿失了！”
“什么，学习这一种个虎魔拳，居然还有对身体的限制！”
“这也正常，越是厉害的武学对于本身肉身的要求也就越高，所谓修行，肉身是基础，万丈高楼平地起，肉身越强，其他的诸多手段才能越厉害！”
“也是，听说厉害的武者甚至能一拳轰塌一个山头，在古代那就是陆地神仙，被当做仙佛供起来吧！”
“教头说的有道理，除非是能修行到，大脑极度开发，滋生神通，有不可思议的伟力，才可以对于肉身没那么依赖呢！”
“那种我们是不敢想了，整个人类这样的存在都是凤毛麟角呢！”
学生们议论纷纷，班上的学生大半都只有第四重，第五重，甚至第三重的也有，只有少数能有第六重以上的修为。
不过他们现在虽然不是第六重，但是未来肯定也会达到的，这个时候先学着也不吃亏。
“看好了！”秦武大吼一声，五指捏拳，然后直接轰了出去，“气走全身，调动全身的肌肉，第一招猛虎下山！”
他这一拳，整个人的气势都变了，就好像真的变成了一头猛虎一样，一拳轰出，居然引起了一阵气爆声。
“第二招，虎啸天下！”
“第三招，猛虎甩头！”
“第四招，猛虎掏心！”
“接下来是最后一招，你们现在谁都学不了的，需要开辟出气海，练成气海境才能够练成的一招，山林之王！”
秦武一连串的动作下来，看的众人眼花缭乱，左手右手不停的出手，隐隐然好像真有一头猛虎下山，捕掠众生。
楚云凡甚至能够感觉到，有罡气从脸上掠过，刮的他的脸颊生疼生疼的。

心中暗道，武技确实厉害，原本十分的实力，通过武技能够发挥出十二分，甚至是二十分的实力，越是厉害的武技，加成也就越是厉害。
他脑海之中，有丹皇的的记忆，里面确实有一些很厉害的武技，尤其是《皇极战典》之中更是记载了许多威力恐怖的武技，但是那都有一个前提，他得达到相应的实力才可以使用出来。
尤其是那些强大的武技都很耗费气血，就算他勉强使用出来，也会一瞬间被耗光气血，变成干尸而死。
所以目前最合适他的，就是虎魔拳这样的武学。
楚云凡感觉自己已经进入了一种玄之又玄的状态，双眸死死的盯住了秦武的身形，那些动作就像是被录像机录了下来，在他的脑海之中不断的回放。
每一次回放，他就感觉自己又学会了几分，在，秦武展示到第三遍的时候，他发现自己已经能够初步掌握虎魔拳了。
不过他也只是记下来，并没有说出来。
“我的演示就到这里了，等一下下课后，我会把修炼虎魔拳的视频发一份到你们的邮箱里，你们在私下里都可以练习，不过别太频繁了，很耗体力的！”秦武说道，“现在我要从你们之中选一个人来演示，有人已经掌握的么？”
“老师，我已经掌握了！”
此时，冯德英举手站了出来，神情骄傲。
“行，你试试！”秦武点点头说道。
冯德英摆开了架势，然后大吼一声：“猛虎下山！”
“虎啸天下！”
“猛虎甩头！”
“猛虎掏心！”

content_en:
Before, whether it was Mu Zhenfei fighting Di Ming or Chu Yunfan defeating Mu Zhenfei with one move, he actually never used martial arts and only relied on his physical fitness to fight.
The function of martial arts is to maximize your physical fitness to defeat your opponent.
So everyone wants to learn, even though the instructor is not teaching any particularly good martial arts, and if you don’t learn it for free, it will be useless.
Everyone's eyes were focused on Qin Wu. Qin Wu paused and said, "I won't emphasize the importance of martial arts. What I want to teach you today is a set of boxing techniques called Tiger Demon Fist. This set of boxing techniques was created by the masters of super ancient civilizations based on a kind of magic tiger at that time!"
"However, this boxing technique also has certain requirements for its own cultivation. Only when you reach the sixth level of the physical realm, where the muscles and bones are in full swing, and the physical body is strong enough, can you practice freely. Most of you have not reached this realm, so you should be careful when practicing. If you feel that you can't bear it, stop practicing. Otherwise, if you leave any hidden injuries, you will lose more than the gain!"
"What, learning this kind of Tiger Demon Fist actually has physical limitations!"
"This is normal. The more powerful the martial arts, the higher the requirements for the physical body. The so-called cultivation, the physical body is the foundation. Tall buildings rise from the ground. The stronger the physical body, the more powerful the other methods will be!"
"Yes, I heard that powerful warriors can even knock down a mountain with one punch. In ancient times, they were land gods, and they were worshiped as immortals and Buddhas!"
"What the instructor said makes sense. Unless you can practice to the point where your brain is extremely developed, you can develop magical powers, and you have incredible power, you won't be so dependent on the physical body!"
"We don't dare to think about that. There are only a handful of such existences in the entire human race!"
The students were talking about it. Most of the students in the class only had the fourth level, fifth level, or even the third level. Only a few could have the sixth level or above.
However, although they are not at the sixth level now, they will definitely reach it in the future. At this time, there is no disadvantage in learning first.
"Watch it!" Qin Wu roared, clenched his fist with five fingers, and then blasted out directly, "Qi drains the whole body, mobilizes the muscles of the whole body, and the tiger comes down the mountain with the first move!"
With this punch, his whole aura changed, as if he had really turned into a tiger. The punch actually caused an explosion of energy.
"The second move, the tiger roars all over the world!"
"The third move, the tiger shakes its head!"
"The fourth move, the tiger takes out the heart!"
"The next step is the last move. None of you can learn it now. You need to open up the Qi Sea and practice the Qi Sea Realm to master it. The King of the Mountain and Forest!"
Qin Wu's series of movements dazzled everyone who saw him. He kept taking action with his left and right hands, and it seemed that there was really a fierce tiger coming down from the mountain, preying on all living beings.
Chu Yunfan could even feel the strong energy passing by his face, causing his cheeks to hurt.
He secretly thought in his mind that martial arts are really powerful. A person who is originally very strong can use martial arts to exert twelve or even twenty points of strength. The more powerful the martial arts, the more powerful the bonus will be.
In his mind, there is the memory of Dan Huang, and there are indeed some very powerful martial arts in it, especially the "Emperor's War Manual" which records many terrifyingly powerful martial arts, but there is a prerequisite for them, he must reach the corresponding strength before he can use them.
Especially those powerful martial arts that consume energy and blood. Even if he manages to use them, his energy and blood will be exhausted in an instant, and he will turn into a mummy and die.
Therefore, the most suitable martial arts for him at present is Tiger Demon Fist.
Chu Yunfan felt that he had entered a mysterious and mysterious state, and his eyes were fixed on Qin Wu's figure. Those movements seemed to be recorded by a video camera, and they were in his mind.Continuously replaying it.
Every time he played it back, he felt like he had learned a little more. When Qin Wu showed it for the third time, he found that he had already mastered the Tiger Demon Fist.
But he just wrote it down and didn't say it out loud.
"That's it for my demonstration. After class, I will send a video of practicing Tiger Demon Fist to your mailbox. You can practice it in private, but don't do it too often, it is very energy-consuming!" Qin Wu said, "Now I want to choose one of you to demonstrate. Has anyone mastered it?"
"Teacher, I have mastered it!"
At this time, Feng Deying stood up with his hands raised, looking proud.
"Okay, try it!" Qin Wu nodded and said.
Feng Deying took a stance and then shouted: "The tiger is coming down the mountain!"
"Tiger roars all over the world!"
"The tiger shakes its head!"
"The tiger rips out the heart!"
